title: AX-8 EVO

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The AGV AX-8 EVO is crafted for intense dirt riding with ultra-wide goggle eyeport stabilization, pairing extreme cooling throughput with competition-grade roost protection. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing a featherweight 1331g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~99 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Ultra-light off-road helmet designed in collaboration with MotoGP riders.

variants.title: AGV AX-8 EVO Gloss Black
variants.description: The AGV AX-8 EVO is a benchmark Dirt / MX helmet crafted in Italy 🇮🇹. Built around 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance, it is engineered specifically for Intermediate Oval ergonomics. Designed for aggressive forward tuck and sport-touring postures, delivering maximum high-speed aerodynamic stability and full-coverage chin protection. Race-bred Italian engineering born on the World Championship grid.

product_details.description: Ultra-light off-road helmet designed in collaboration with MotoGP riders.

variants.introduction: Positioned in AGV's Dirt / MX lineup, the AX-8 EVO brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
variants.story:
The AGV AX-8 EVO represents AGV's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~99 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the AGV AX-8 EVO delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
variants.finish_profile: AGV AX-8 EVO Gloss Black (gloss finish) — Treated with a mirror-finish deep gloss clearcoat that repels road grime and simplifies bug cleanup.
variants.editorial_note: AGV AX-8 EVO in AGV AX-8 EVO Gloss Black. A race-ready dirt helmet pairing wide-angle eyeport goggle seating with lightweight shell balance for competitive off-road riders.
variants.fitment_notes: Contoured for Intermediate Oval ergonomics with high-density moisture-wicking cheek pads and neck roll designed to keep helmet locked in place during heavy terrain vibration. 10–12 riding hours break-in expected.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a snug, locked-in fit typical of motocross; features an extended cheek pad system to accommodate larger head sizes without compromising stability. Optimized for Intermediate Oval head shapes.

technical_analysis: Features 100% 3K Carbon Fiber shell construction developed under AGV Extreme Safety protocol for MotoGP performance paired with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view. The interior utilizes 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the AGV AX-8 EVO: combining Italy 🇮🇹 craftsmanship with Class-1 optical Ultravision shield offering 190° horizontal and 85° vertical field of view and 360° Adaptive Fit crown structure with 2Dry moisture-wicking Shalimar & Ritmo fabric lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: AGV AX-8 EVO: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the AGV AX-8 EVO. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The AGV AX-8 EVO is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Minimal air-snag during shoulder checks; low drag profile keeps neck muscles relaxed during highway lane changes.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low to Moderate (Standard intermediate oval contour fits 85% of riders without forehead red spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

editorial_overview: The AGV AX-8 EVO is crafted for intense dirt riding with ultra-wide goggle eyeport stabilization, pairing extreme cooling throughput with competition-grade roost protection. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing a featherweight 1331g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~99 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.
rider_takeaway: A race-ready dirt helmet pairing wide-angle eyeport goggle seating with lightweight shell balance for competitive off-road riders.

rider_persona.core_priority: Unrestricted goggle airflow, high-clearance roost beak, and maximum aerobic heat dissipation

acoustic_envelope.practical_effect: Direct acoustic exposure to ambient environmental sounds and road wind; dedicated hearing protection strongly recommended at speeds above 80 km/h.
